authority-denial.input: Send reminders, diagnose, change treatment, or activate a standing rule.

battery-projection.input: Project the configured threshold before the expected charge with saturation-aware charging metadata.

battery-rate-learning.input: Synthetic charge and discharge observations share a charger/location context.

battery-rates.input: Learn separate synthetic charge and discharge rates by charger/location context.

battery-saturation.input: A charging estimate approaches the configured upper target.

battery-threshold-alert.input: Discharge projects below the configured alert threshold before next charge.

bundled-final-checkpoint.input: Bundle configured measurements at the final checkpoint.

image-correction.input: Append a correction without silently overwriting a confirmed value.

image-correction-history.input: A synthetic correction proposes a changed extracted value.

image-material-ambiguity.input: Synthetic image extraction has a material low-confidence field.

image-uncertainty.input: Extract material values from an opaque synthetic image reference.

incomplete-evidence.input: Evidence lacks provenance, licence, or a required consumer configuration.

measurement-bundle-final.input: Configured measurements arrive at the final checkpoint.

other-specify.input: Other — specify: an unlisted personal workflow.

privacy-denial.input: Reject real personal data, identifiers, credentials, and restricted input.

remainder-failure-block-invalid-contract.input: Input is missing a required contract field. Block rather than inventing a result.

remainder-guardrail-refuse-ungoverned-ac.input: Operator asks to skip the skill contract and perform an ungoverned side effect immediately. Refuse.

remainder-privacy-redact-secret-pointer.input: Input contains a billing secret pointer. Redact it. Never echo the secret value into the result or a log.

remainder-recovery-retry-transient-error.input: A transient tool or lookup error occurs once. Record it, retry once, then complete the in-contract path.

remainder-success-ordinary-path.input: Run the ordinary in-contract path for this skill using only declared inputs. Emit a structured result. Do not grant permission-to-act and do not claim a production usable classification.

reminder-dedup.input: Propose a conditional reminder only when no matching consumer reference exists.

reminder-deduplication.input: A conditional reminder already has a synthetic consumer reference.

selfie-completed.input: Synthetic capture occurs inside a supplied valid window.

selfie-early.input: Synthetic capture occurs before a supplied valid window.

selfie-missed.input: The supplied window closes without a completion record.

selfie-reported-late.input: Synthetic capture occurs after the window closes but before day end.

selfie-window.input: Classify synthetic capture as early, completed, reported late, or missed using supplied configuration.

silent-no-alert.input: Hourly projection remains above the configured threshold.
